tei:div.tei:p: stag tshang lo tswa ba shes rab rin chen gyi gsung 'bum 'di ni/ ris med rgyal bstan spyi la lhag bsam dang dag snang mchog tu mnga' ba/ dpal na lan+ḍa'i mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang*/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma rnam gnyis kyi thugs bskyed las da lta rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul rgyu byung ba yin/ de yang mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mchog gis dus dang rnam pa kun tu dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams srung skyob bya rgyu gal chen du rtsis te 'bad rtsol rgya chen gnang bar thos la/ khyad par du dpe rgyun kha 'thor du gyur pa'i rong ston shes bya kun rig gi gsung 'bum dang*/ stag tshang lo tswa ba shes rab rin chen gyi gsung 'bum gnyis 'tshol bsdu'i ched 'bad rtsol rgya chen gnang ste/ pe cing mi rigs rig gnas pho brang dang*/ 'bras spung dgon/ sa skya dgon/ rtse po ta la/ nang sog dpe mdzod sogs sa gnas mang por btsal 'tshol du sku dngos ngo phebs gnang zhing*/ ma zad nyid kyi slob ma nor brang o rgyan/ khams sprul bsod nams don grub/ bsod nams tshe 'phel/ yum pa sogs la bka' mngags gnang ste 'tshol bsdu mdzad pas/ rong ston bka' 'bum 'tshol bsdu thub pa rnams sku tsha bsod nams tshe 'phel nas 'gan khur zhus pa bzhin da lta dpe skrun legs grub zin shing*/ khong nyid nas kyang sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i gsung 'bum sde dge'i shing par du ma 'khod pa gsar du rnyed pa'i po ti gsum tshar lnga brgya par te bshad grwa dang gdan sa khag la gnang zhing*/ stag lo'i gsung 'bum 'tshol bsdu dang myur skyob kyi bka' mngags gang gi slob ma karma bde legs la gnang*/ de nas spyi lo2002lo'i zla ba dang por karma bde legs khams phyogs ky-i sa gnas khag cig tu dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu'i ched 'gro khar| skyogs lo ngag dbang bkra shis kyi phyag bris 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sum bid bris ma byin can zhig dang*/

mi dmangs shog sgor 1000tham pa/ kha btags nyin mo bde legs bcas gnang nas zhal ta gang mang dang*/ las ka legs grub yong ba'i shis smon kyang mdzad/ karma bde legs nas khams phyogs kyi las ka rnams grub te/ 'bras spungs dgon gyi dpe rnying myur skyob byed skabs mkhan rin po che zhi bar gshegs zin mod/ khong gis mkhan rin po che'i zhal chems dang*/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma mchog nas ma dpe 'tshol bsdu'i 'gro song dang bka' slob mdzub ston 'og stag lo'i gsung 'bum lo ngo lnga yi ring mdo khams dbus gtsang*/ phyi gling gi dpe mdzod khag cig gtsos rgyal khab dang sa gnas mang po nas 'bad 'tshol byas nas rnyed pa'i chos tshan65la pod bdun dang*/ stag lo'i khu bo dpon yig dpal 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba bcas 'ja' lus su 'gro la khad kyi dpe rnying 'di dag deb chung brgyad du bgos te/ nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis gnyer ba'i mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa'i dpe tshogs kyi khongs su/ spar skrun zhus te mkhyen ldan gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul rgyu yin/spyir stag lo'i bka' 'bum la stag lo'i dngos slob rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dpal 'byor gyis gsung 'bum phyogs sgrig byas pa kun la po ti bcu grangs tsam zhig yod par shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dpal 'byor gyi rnam thar las gsungs shing*/gzhan yang stag lo'i nye gnas lha yi dbang phyug dang*/ dge slong grub pa rgyal mtshan sogs kyis gtsang chos 'khor sgang du stag lo zhi bar gshegs nas lo bdun song ba/ bod rab byung brgyad pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1484lor shing spar du brkaus pa'i rig gnas kun shes rtsa 'grel dang*/ yang de nas lo bzhi song ba sa sprel lor dus 'khor dkyil chog sogs khag gcig shing spar la bkod pa mjal rgyu byung ba dang*/

rnam thar kha skong du'ang 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dpal 'byor gyis stag lo'i bka' 'bum pu ti bcu gsum phyogs gcig tu bsdebs par gsungs pa dang*/ da lta nga tshos ma dpe bris ma rnyed son byung ba mang po la shing spar gyi spar byang 'khod yod pa bcas la gzhig na/ gsung 'bum phal che ba shing spar la brkaus kyang rjes su dus kyi 'pho 'gyur gyi rkyain pas nyams chag shor ba mngon/ stag lo'i bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa zhig da sngon ma mjal yang*/ rang rnam las gsung pa dang*/ rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dpal 'byor gyi rnam thar/ dus 'khor spyi don bstan pa rgya mtsho sogs rang gzhung dag las kha 'phangs pa las gsal ba ltar na/ gzhung lugs grags chen bco brgyad sogs gtso bor mdo phyogs kyi 'grel ba dang*/ gsang 'dus bde mchog kyai rdor dus 'khor sogs kyi rgyud 'grel dang dkyil chog sogs chos tshan nyis brgya brgyad cu tsam yod par mngon yang*/ da lta nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo ngo lnga yi ring 'tshol bsdu thub par chos tshan65tsam las ma rnyed/ 'on kyang gzhung sger 'ga' shas kyi phyag la stag lo'i gsung tshan pa kha shas yod tshul thos pas/ dpe g.yar rgyu'i re ba zhus par don smin ma byung bar blo pham dang yid chad ngang re zhig deb chung bdun po 'di spar bskrun zhus pa yin/ da dung chos tshan200lhag tsam ma 'ong par 'tshol bsdu bya dgos pa rnams mtshan tho zur du bkod yod pas spyi dang bye brag gi bstan la kha tsam min par lhag bsam zhig gal srid mchis na snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'brug skad ltar chems shing*/ phyogs lhung gi thog mdas rgyal bstan mthun sgril gyi gser mkhar gtor ba la ma brtson par/ bstan dang 'gro bar sman pa'i gsung rab dpe rnying dag 'tshol bsdu dang myur skyobs bya rogs zhes thal mo snying khar sbyar te gsol ba lan brgyar 'debs pa lags/

/ bka' 'bum 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang dpe sgrig 'gan 'dzin karma bde legs dang*/ spyi khyab las ka'i 'gan khur ba mkhan po 'gro 'dul rdo rje gnyis yin/ zhu dag thengs dang po dang gnyis pa thub bstan smon lam dang ngag dbang bzang po gnyis/ zhu dag thengs gsum pa dang mtha' ma'i zhus chen gus pas khur blang nas zhus pa yin/ ma dpe'i skung yig rnams gzhung gong 'og dang*/ dpe mi 'dra ba khag zhib bsdur thog 'phyugs med du bkral pa dang*/ phrad sbyor yig nor mngon gsal dag bcos pa phud/ ma dpe'i nang don la bcos lhad spu tsam yang ma byas par tha na yul skad thad kar bris pa rnams kyang rang sor bzhag yod/ ches dpe rnying gi dbang gis tshig 'bru mi gsal ba dang*/ rtsa chad song rigs la 'ol tshod kyis kha ma skang bar tshag rtags rgyab ste stong par bzhag yod/ rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song sogs ni dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gis zhus shing*/ spar skrun gyi 'gro song ches brin bod sman khang nas btang ba dang gzhan yang zhu dag byed skabs 'gro song la rogs ram gnang mkhan mkhan po rta mgrin rdo rje dang*/ khams sprul bsod nams don grub/ sgra ṭika zhu dag pa gling dbon pad+ma skal bzang dang rdo rje nyi ma/ zhu dag spyi'i brda gsar rnying sogs la grogs dan pa bstan 'dzin blo gros/ rtsis 'khor deb sgrig pa tshe ring sgrol ma/ skal bzang lha mo/ shes rab dpal g.yang*/ ye shes chos mtsho sogs kyis bgyis te rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul thub pa byung*/ zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas thub bstan nyi mas so/ / PAGE bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ PAGE -PAGE 8--7-
